verdict.summary_en: Soony Interactive GmbH procurement organisation chart, version 2, dated 2026-11-21. It shows the CPO (Jonas Lindqvist) over the Head of Procurement (Dr. Maren Vogt). Five direct reports sit under the Head: three category leads with buyers, a Supplier Quality Lead and a Logistics Planner. DC Hamburg's site lead has a dotted line to the Head of Procurement. Three other roles are listed below the chart. Arjun Krishnan is highlighted as Category Lead Collector's Items effective 2026-11-23. Approval limits are not on this chart and are referred to Approval Policy PP-07.
red_flags: Arjun Krishnan's role as Category Lead Collector's Items takes effect 2026-11-23, which is after the chart date of 2026-11-21. It is highlighted on the chart.
The chart gives no approval limits. It refers to Approval Policy PP-07.
observations: The chart is a typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The Arjun Krishnan box is shaded, which marks the upcoming change.
The first read with page rendering failed because pdftoppm is missing. A read without the pages parameter worked and returned the text and the image.
